name: taskfsm
description: Connect Codex CLI runs to TaskFSM observability and managed task lifecycle

interface.shortDescription: Observe and manage Codex tasks through TaskFSM
interface.longDescription: Adds TaskFSM worker guidance for Codex. In observed mode TaskFSM only projects native Codex sessions; in managed mode Codex uses TaskFSM MCP tools for progress, artifacts, heartbeat, and review transitions.
defaultPrompt: 执行当前 TaskFSM 任务并持续上报进度
